description: Create header and footer sections including announcement bar, main header with navigation/search/cart, mobile menu, and footer with multiple columns. Also create the section group JSON files that the layout references.
steps: Create sections/header-group.json section group file with order array referencing announcement-bar and header sections.
Create sections/footer-group.json section group file with order array referencing footer section.

Create sections/announcement-bar.liquid with: scrolling marquee of trust badges, schema with settings for background_color, text_color, scroll_speed range, show_announcement checkbox. Include blocks type 'badge' with text and icon_name settings. Default 4 blocks: Free Shipping, 24/7 Support, Secure Payments, Proud Indian Culture. Set enabled_on groups header only.

Create sections/header.liquid with: logo (image or text fallback), main navigation using linklists['main-menu'], search icon triggering search drawer, account icon linking to /account, cart icon with item count badge, mobile hamburger menu button. Schema settings: logo image_picker, logo_width range, sticky_header checkbox, show_search checkbox, show_account checkbox, menu_style select (dropdown/mega). Set enabled_on groups header only.

Create sections/mobile-menu.liquid as drawer overlay with: close button, navigation links from main-menu, search form, account/cart links. Schema settings for background_color, text_color, animation_style select.

Create sections/footer.liquid with: 4 column grid (About, Quick Links, Customer Service, Newsletter), social icons snippet, payment icons snippet, copyright text. Schema with blocks for 'menu_column' (title, menu linklist picker), 'text_column' (title, richtext content), 'newsletter' (title, placeholder_text). Settings for background_color, text_color, show_payment_icons checkbox, show_social_icons checkbox, copyright_text text field. Set enabled_on groups footer only.

Update assets/theme.css with styles for: sticky header, announcement bar marquee animation, navigation dropdowns, mega menu layout, mobile menu drawer with slide animation, footer grid layout, responsive breakpoints for header/footer.
Update assets/theme.js with: mobile menu open/close toggle, search drawer toggle, sticky header scroll behavior (add/remove class on scroll), mega menu hover interactions.
acceptance_criteria: sections/header-group.json is valid JSON with type 'header' and sections object containing announcement-bar and header
sections/footer-group.json is valid JSON with type 'footer' and sections object containing footer
sections/announcement-bar.liquid has valid schema with badge blocks and scrolling marquee markup
sections/header.liquid renders logo, navigation, and action icons with proper schema settings
sections/mobile-menu.liquid is a drawer component with navigation and proper close functionality
sections/footer.liquid renders multi-column layout with blocks for flexible content
Header becomes sticky on scroll when enabled
Mobile menu toggles open/closed on hamburger click
verification: Validate JSON syntax of sections/header-group.json and sections/footer-group.json
Check all section files have {% schema %} tags with valid JSON inside
Verify header.liquid references linklists['main-menu'] for navigation
Verify footer.liquid includes {% render 'social-icons' %} and {% render 'payment-icons' %}
findings: All files created and validated successfully. Header-group.json and footer-group.json are valid JSON with correct structure. All section files (announcement-bar.liquid, header.liquid, mobile-menu.liquid, footer.liquid) have valid schema JSON. Header uses linklists['main-menu'] for navigation. Footer renders both social-icons and payment-icons snippets. CSS includes styles for sticky header, announcement bar marquee animation, navigation dropdowns, mega menu layout, mobile menu drawer with slide animation, and footer grid layout. JS includes mobile menu toggle with submenu support, search drawer toggle, sticky header scroll behavior, and mega menu hover interactions.
